summary: Viking Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing top-line results from a maintenance study of its GLP-1/GIP dual agonist VK2735, furnished via Exhibit 99.1 press release under Items 8.01 and 9.01. The company reported 22% placebo-adjusted weight loss at Week 33 with weekly 17.5 mg dosing, no observed plateau, and up to 97% weight loss maintenance on every-other-week dosing and up to 90% on monthly dosing over three months, with GI adverse events comparable to placebo. No transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is stated; this is a routine clinical data disclosure with no special-situation elements, and a conference call was scheduled.
